title: The L1 relay's rolling call: its calldata, record framing, call hashes, deposit data, and the relay's one sequence of both calls
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/relay-rolling-vectors.py (Python standard library only, over relay-vectors.py's Keccak-256, slots and accumulator; one ballot from ballot-v5-records.json)

The same call with step N0 - 1's root: another call hash, since the hash binds the root
The same record and root relayed again, one slot later

A root of 0: recorded and deposited, since the relay never judges the root; the board refuses it (membership-proof)
A root of r, not a field element: recorded, and refused by the board

framing.description: 34 bytes: the definition hash one byte short
